notes: The supplied *the* of *all the days* is placed on `יְמֵי`, the construct noun it stands before, rather than on `כֹּל`, under rule 29's counting direction and its allowance of a supplied determiner on a construct where no article morpheme is present. `כֹּל` takes only its own *all*, the ASV writing no *of* after it for rule 19 to place.

`בְּטוּב יְרוּשָׁלִָם`: the `בְּ` is `unrepresented` under rule 40 because the ASV recasts *look on* as a plain transitive *see*, promoting the preposition's object to the direct object and spending no word on the relation.
*see thou*: no vocative stands in the clause, so the supplied pronoun is the imperative's own subject pronoun under rule 17 rather than rule 36's vocative *ye*.
